description: Naive autoregressive recompute vs. cached generation (KV cache for DiffAttn, history-accumulation for Mamba2). Single GPU, bfloat16, batch size 1.
notes: Memory reduction is the headline win for the current cache implementation: 22-26%.
Speed is roughly equivalent in this build: attention uses true KV caching, but the Mamba path re-runs over accumulated history rather than using the proper SSM step function.
Implementing Mamba2.step() caching is left as future work and would yield the expected ~10x speedup.
